messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Texts in Legend
parts:
MERRY CHRISTMAS

Please consider the following code :

library(zoo); library(ggplot2)
dat <- zooreg(cbind(rnorm(50), runif(50)), start=as.yearmon
("2001-01-01"), frequency=12)
dat1 <- data.frame(data1 = as.vector(coredata(dat)), variable = rep(c
("ABCDE", "A"), each=50)); dat1
ggplot(dat1) +
geom_line(aes(y=data1, x=as.numeric(index(dat)),
colour=variable), group=Variable, size = 1.3)

Please look at the legend of this plot. Is it possible to align the
texts in the legend to left, which currently is right aligned ?

Thanks,

messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Re: Texts in Legend

legend? Can I have any control on that?

Thanks,

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Texts in Legend
parts:
I think this might be a bug. All(?) legend labels appear to be
right-aligned in ggplot version 0.8.5. For example:

dsmall <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds), 100), ]
(d <- qplot(carat, price, data=dsmall, shape=cut))

gives me a right-aligned legend, although this example on the website
shows the legend text left-aligned.

I can't imagine that this is the intended behavior (it is best to
minimize the distance your eye has to travel between the geom
indicator and it's label).
